name: ggml
description: Tensor library for machine learning. Wabcut overlay: the ggml that whisper.cpp v1.9.5 ships (so whisper-cpp and ggml always match), with SIMD on, CPU variants picked at run time (GGML_BACKEND_DL + GGML_CPU_ALL_VARIANTS) and an optional Vulkan backend.

vulkan.description: Vulkan backend (headers, loader, SPIR-V headers and glslc all from vcpkg, no Vulkan SDK)
